tasks.label: Bee My Office: Start MariaDB
args: $mysql = 'C:\xampp\mysql\bin'; & "$mysql\mysqladmin.exe" --connect-timeout=2 -h 127.0.0.1 -u root ping *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Start-Process -FilePath "$mysql\mysqld.exe" -ArgumentList @('--defaults-file=' + "$mysql\my.ini", '--console') -WindowStyle Minimized; $ready = $false; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; & "$mysql\mysqladmin.exe" --connect-timeout=2 -h 127.0.0.1 -u root ping *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $ready = $true; break } }; if (-not $ready) { throw 'MariaDB did not start. Check XAMPP and confirm port 3306 is available.' } }

tasks.label: Bee My Office: PHP Server
args: $url = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api.php?resource=services'; curl.exe --silent --fail $url -o nul *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output 'Bee My Office PHP server already running'; exit 0 }; & 'C:\xampp\php\php.exe' -S 127.0.0.1:8000 router.php

background.beginsPattern: PHP [0-9.]+ Development Server|Bee My Office PHP server already running
background.endsPattern: Development Server \(http://127\.0\.0\.1:8000\) started|Bee My Office PHP server already running
